verdict.rationale: Requesty's Fallback Policies explicitly retry requests against alternate models when a provider fails with a timeout, rate limit, or error, which covers the core intent of retrying on transient provider errors. However, this is model-fallback rather than a configurable same-model retry policy, and there's no documented control over retry counts, backoff intervals, or which error codes trigger retries. missing for 10: explicit retry-count/backoff configuration, evidence of same-model automatic retries (not just model fallback), independent/hands-on confirmation of retry behavior.
